title: Support, mass and boundary of a difference of currents
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, U, W ⊆ Euclid P and A, B ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n): spt(A − B) ⊆ spt A ∪ spt B and M_W(A − B) ≤ M_W(A) + M_W(B). For all P, m ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ Euclid P and A, B ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U): spt ∂A ⊆ spt A and ∂(A − B) = ∂A − ∂B.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), (A - B).support ⊆ A.support ∪ B.support ∧ (A - B).massOn W ≤ A.massOn W + B.massOn W) ∧ ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), A.boundary.support ⊆ A.support ∧ (A - B).boundary = A.boundary - B.boundary
